तितिक्षा

TITIKṢĀ . One of the sixteen daughters born to dakṣa of his wife prasūti. Of these thirteen were married to Dharmadeva. titikṣā was one of them. The others were śraddhā, maitrī etc. (4th skandha bhāgavata).

तितिक्षु

TITIKṢU . A King born of the family of turvasu. He was the son of uśīnara and father of ruṣadratha. (Chapter 277, agni purāṇa).

तित्तिर

TITTIRA . A place of habitation in ancient bhārata. (Śloka 51, Chapter 50, bhīṣma parva).

तित्तिरि १

TITTIRI I . A kind of bird. To know about the origin of this bird see under the head triśiras.

तित्तिरि २

TITTIRI II . A celebrated serpent born to the sage kaśyapa of kadrū, his wife. (Śloka 15, Chapter 35, Ādi Parva).

तित्तिरि ३

TITTIRI III . A sage who was a member of the council of yudhiṣṭhira. (Śloka 12, Chapter 4, Sabhā Parva).

तित्तिरि ४

TITTIRI IV . A special breed of horses. arjuna got this breed from gandharvanagara during his victory campaign. (Śloka 6, Chapter 28, Sabhā Parva).
